name: settings-required-state
title: Settings required state
description: Empty state shown when required configuration is missing, with a call-to-action whose navigation stays in the host.
postInstall: Render <SettingsRequiredState labels={...} title={...} settingsHref={...} onOpenSettings={...} /> wherever a feature needs its configuration first. The host supplies the translated action label, the in-app settings path and the navigation callback. Requires the shadcn ui primitives button and card.
